string.name: usb_hint_no_devices
string.value:
No USB devices detected: this device is currently acting as the console’s USB device. With a C-to-C cable the two ends decide which one becomes the host each time they’re plugged in, so unplugging and reconnecting a few times may help.
The most reliable option is an OTG adapter (USB-C male → USB-A female on this device) plus a USB-A to USB-C cable to the console’s bottom port; the OTG adapter keeps this device as USB host.
Changing only the power direction (e.g. reverse charging) doesn’t make the phone the host.

string.name: usb_hint_nintendo
string.value: A console (VID 057E) was found, but it isn't SysDVR. Open SysDVR Settings on the console, set the mode to USB and apply. If another homebrew app is using USB (e.g. MTP, Goldleaf), close it first.

string.name: usb_hint_no_sysdvr
string.value: This device is the USB host, but no SysDVR device is present. Make sure SysDVR is set to USB mode, the console is in handheld mode (not docked), and the cable is in the console's bottom USB-C port.
